description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management; risk strategy, expectations, and policy are established and communicated.
title: Organizational cybersecurity risk management strategy

description: Inventories of systems, software, services, and data are maintained and authorized.
title: Asset inventory

description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed; access is authorized and least-privilege enforced.
title: Access control and identity management

description: Networks, systems, and assets are continuously monitored to find anomalies and indicators of compromise.
title: Continuous monitoring

description: Incidents are reported consistent with established criteria to internal and external stakeholders.
title: Incident reporting

description: Recovery plans are executed during or after a cybersecurity incident, restoring operations.
title: Recovery planning

description: Clear accountability for technology and cyber risk, with board and senior management oversight of the technology risk framework.
title: Technology governance and accountability

description: Preventive, detective, and responsive cyber security controls protecting technology assets and data.
title: Cyber security controls

description: Risks from third-party technology providers are identified, assessed, and managed across the provider lifecycle.
title: Third-party technology risk

description: Technology operations can withstand and recover from disruptions; resilience tested through exercises.
title: Technology resilience

description: Material technology and cyber incidents are reported to OSFI promptly, including the 72-hour incident reporting expectation.
title: Technology and cyber incident reporting to OSFI

description: Each covered entity must maintain a cybersecurity program designed to protect information systems and nonpublic information.
title: Cybersecurity program

description: A qualified CISO (employed or via affiliate/third-party) must oversee and enforce the cybersecurity program and report to the board.
title: Chief Information Security Officer

description: Periodic risk assessments of information systems, updated as needed, informing the cybersecurity program.
title: Risk assessment

description: Encryption of nonpublic information at rest and in transit, with compensating controls where encryption is infeasible.
title: Encryption of nonpublic information

description: Notification to the superintendent within 72 hours of a cybersecurity event with a reasonable likelihood of material harm, and within 72 hours of any ransomware payment.
title: Cybersecurity event notification (72 hours)

description: Licensees must implement a comprehensive written information security program commensurate with size, complexity, and data sensitivity.
title: Information security program

description: Notification to the state insurance commissioner within 72 hours of a cybersecurity event affecting 250+ consumers.
title: Cybersecurity event notification to commissioner (72 hours)

description: Due diligence and contractual security requirements for third-party service providers with access to nonpublic information.
title: Third-party service provider oversight

description: The board of directors must require executive management to develop and maintain the information security program.
title: Board oversight of information security

description: Network security controls (firewalls, segmentation) protect cardholder data environments.
title: Install and maintain network security controls

description: Anti-malware mechanisms protect systems against viruses, worms, trojans, and other malicious software.
title: Protect against malicious software

description: Strong authentication, including multi-factor authentication for remote and administrative access.
title: Identify users and authenticate access

description: Logging mechanisms and the ability to track user activities are in place; logs are reviewed.
title: Log and monitor all access

description: Regular testing including vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and intrusion detection.
title: Test security of systems and networks regularly

description: Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures are implemented to protect against threats.
title: Logical access security (CC6.1)

description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of controls for anomalies indicative of malicious acts or processing errors.
title: System monitoring (CC7.2)

description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they are incidents and responds accordingly.
title: Incident evaluation and response (CC7.3)

description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors backup and recovery infrastructure.
title: Backup and recovery (A1.2)
